prompts.prompt_en:
Hand-drawn doodle illustration, flat color cartoon style with thick uneven black ink outlines, slightly wobbly lines, simple shapes, no gradients, no shading. Warm cream paper background (#F8F0DC). 16:9 split-screen composition divided by a thin vertical dark gray line in the exact center.

LEFT HALF: a vintage round stopwatch in beige-brown tone with two small buttons on top, clean white clock face with simple tick marks, and a bold green checkmark drawn over the face. Centered in the upper two thirds of the left half.

RIGHT HALF: a clump of tall, dry, spiky golden-brown grass blades with black outlines. Two glowing yellow cat-like eyes with narrow black vertical pupils peeking out from inside the grass. A big black hand-drawn question mark floating at the upper right of the grass. Centered in the upper two thirds of the right half.

Leave an empty cream-colored band at the bottom of both halves for text labels added later. Minimalist educational explainer video style, clean and uncluttered. No text, no letters, no words, no numbers.
